items.why: Nvidia stock is tumbling after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, per WSJ live updates.
The VIX is climbing after the market shake-out, with headlines warning it may be too soon to say the worst is over.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
AMD is bouncing, with Wedbush seeing $600, though it is still down 32% in a month.

market_note: Futures are lower, with the S&P down 0.37% and the Nasdaq down 0.73%.
summary: Stocks are lower early as Nvidia tumbles after CEO Jensen Huang resigned, dragging the Nasdaq down while the VIX jumps and bitcoin and gold slide.
